faqs.question: How do I raise an HR ticket?
faqs.answer: Open Helpdesk, choose HR, click **Raise ticket**, pick a category and sub-category, write a clear title and description, attach files if needed, and submit. You get a ticket ID.

faqs.question: How do I check the status of my ticket?
faqs.answer: Open **My Tickets**. Your open tickets are on the **Open Tickets** page with status, assignee and SLA due date. You can also ask the AI bar on the Dashboard, for example "What is the status of my payroll ticket?". Click a ticket to see the conversation and timeline.

faqs.question: What do the statuses mean?
faqs.answer: **Open**: waiting to be picked up. **In Progress**: an HR agent is working on it. **Waiting for employee**: HR needs more information from you. **Closed**: it has been resolved, rejected or cancelled, with a closing response.

faqs.question: How is my ticket prioritised?
faqs.answer: You do not choose a priority. Each ticket is prioritised automatically from its category and the details you give, and your HR agent can adjust it.

faqs.question: How long will I wait for a reply?
faqs.answer: Each category has a response time and a resolution time. Your ticket shows the SLA due dates. The target times are [to be confirmed by HR].

faqs.question: Are my HR tickets private?
faqs.answer: Tickets in sensitive categories (for example payroll, personal records, grievances) are visible only to you, the assigned agent, the category lead and people you or the agent add as followers. [Confirm the category list with HR.]

faqs.question: What if my ticket is not answered in time?
faqs.answer: The ticket escalates automatically to the next level (category lead, then HR management). You do not need to raise it again.

faqs.question: Can I reopen a closed ticket?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the category allows it. Open the ticket from the Closed Tickets page or History page and click **Reopen**, then add a note. [Reopen window to be confirmed.]

faqs.question: How do I follow a colleague's ticket or add someone to mine?
faqs.answer: Add people as followers on the ticket. They will see it on the **Following** page and receive updates. Followers cannot change the status.

faqs.question: Where can I see my old tickets?
faqs.answer: Use the **History** page. Closed HR tickets are listed there with their closing response.

faqs.question: How do I request a course or LinkedIn Learning licence?
faqs.answer: Raise an L&D ticket, choose the **Course request** type, select the learning source and item, and add a short business justification. Your manager and L&D will review it.

faqs.question: Who approves course requests?
faqs.answer: Your manager approves first, then L&D. [Confirm the approval chain with the L&D Head.] You can see the approval status on the ticket.

faqs.question: I cannot log in to the L&D portal. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Raise an **L&D portal access** ticket. Include the error message, your browser and the time it happened. If company single sign-on fails for every app, not only the L&D portal, raise an **IT and Support** ticket under Account and password instead.

faqs.question: My LinkedIn Learning access shows an error after signing in.
faqs.answer: Raise a ticket under L&D portal access, sub-category LinkedIn Learning duplicate email. Common causes are a duplicate email address or a licence not yet assigned.

faqs.question: A course or video does not load. What can I do?
faqs.answer: Try another browser and clear cache first. If it still fails, raise a **Content and playback** ticket with the course name, the page and a screenshot.

faqs.question: I completed a course but I did not get a certificate.
faqs.answer: Raise a **Certificates and records** ticket with the course name and completion date. Note that LinkedIn Learning issues one certificate per course, on first completion; repeating a course does not create a new one.

faqs.question: I am not mapped to my training session.
faqs.answer: Raise a **Training sessions** ticket with the session name and date. Sessions within the next two days are handled first. [Confirm rule with L&D.]

faqs.question: How do I join a Skillup Lounge?
faqs.answer: Raise a **Course request** with the learning source Skillup Lounge, or check the lounge schedule published by L&D. [Confirm process with L&D.]

faqs.question: Can I cancel or change a course request?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open the ticket and add a comment, or ask the L&D coordinator to cancel it. A cancelled ticket moves to History as Cancelled.

faqs.question: Where can I see my L&D ticket history?
faqs.answer: Open **History**, choose L&D, and filter by date or status.

faqs.question: How do I raise an IT ticket?
faqs.answer: Open Helpdesk, click **Raise ticket**, choose **IT and Support**, pick a category and sub-category, and fill the fields that appear. You can also tap the mic and describe the problem; AI fills the form for you to check. You get an IT ticket ID such as IT-000123.

faqs.question: My laptop is slow, broken or flickering. What should I include?
faqs.answer: Choose **Hardware and IT asset**. Add the asset tag from the sticker (for example NPX-LT-0412), the device type, the exact error and who is affected. Attach a photo or screenshot if you can.

faqs.question: How do I request new software or a licence?
faqs.answer: Choose **Software and installation**, then Install new software or Software licence request. Add the software name and a business justification. Your manager approves first, then IT installs it. [Confirm the licence budget rule with IT.]

faqs.question: How do I get access to a shared folder, VPN or a company system?
faqs.answer: Choose **Access and permissions**. Pick the system, access level and duration. Your manager approves by default. Admin rights also need the IT head. [Confirm duration limits with IT.]

faqs.question: I forgot my password or my account is locked.
faqs.answer: Try the self-service reset first. [Confirm the reset portal link.] If it still fails, raise **Account and password**. These are handled urgently.

faqs.question: Wi-Fi or VPN is not working. What do I do?
faqs.answer: Choose **Network and connectivity**. Add your location and floor, and say whether only you or the whole floor is affected. Whole-floor problems are worked first.

faqs.question: I received a suspicious email.
faqs.answer: Do not click links or forward it. Raise **Security and incident**, sub-category Phishing email reported. These tickets are confidential: only you, IT security, the IT head and helpdesk admins can see them.

faqs.question: My laptop was lost or stolen.
faqs.answer: Raise **Security and incident**, sub-category Lost or stolen device, straight away so IT can lock it. If your ID card was lost too, raise a separate Admin Desk ticket and link it as a related ticket.

faqs.question: How do I set up IT for a new joiner?
faqs.answer: The manager raises **New joiner IT setup** at least 5 working days before the joining date [to be confirmed]. Link the related Admin Desk seat ticket and the HR onboarding ticket so all teams see each other.

faqs.question: Is a problem with the L&D portal an IT issue?
faqs.answer: No. Problems with the L&D portal or LinkedIn Learning go to **L&D**. Company sign-in, MFA, email accounts and devices go to **IT and Support**. If you pick the wrong helpdesk, the form suggests the right one.

faqs.question: How do I raise an Admin Desk ticket?
faqs.answer: Open Helpdesk, click **Raise ticket**, choose **Admin Desk**, pick a category and fill the fields that appear. You get an Admin Desk ticket ID such as ADM-000045.

faqs.question: Something in the office needs repair (AC, lights, plumbing).
faqs.answer: Choose **Facilities and maintenance**. Add the building, floor, exact spot and urgency. Choose Immediately for anything unsafe, such as sparks or water near sockets; that flags it for the Admin Desk to act on straight away.

faqs.question: How do I book travel?
faqs.answer: Choose **Travel and accommodation**. Add from, to, dates, purpose and travellers. Your manager approves, then the travel desk books and attaches the tickets. [Confirm the advance-booking rule.]

faqs.question: Who approves travel and purchases?
faqs.answer: Travel: your manager. Purchases and vendor requests: your manager, then the Admin head. [Confirm cost thresholds with Admin.] You can see each approval step on the ticket.

faqs.question: How do I get a parking slot or office cab?
faqs.answer: Choose **Transport and parking**. For parking, add the vehicle registration (for example MH 02 AB 1234). For cabs and late-night drops, add the shift time.

faqs.question: I lost my ID card. What now?
faqs.answer: Raise **ID card and access badge**, sub-category Lost card. The old card is deactivated and reception gives you a temporary pass until the new card is printed.

faqs.question: How do I register a visitor?
faqs.answer: Choose **Visitors and meeting rooms**, sub-category Visitor pass, at least one working day before the visit [to be confirmed]. Add the date and visitor names.

faqs.question: How do I send a courier?
faqs.answer: Choose **Courier and mail**. Add the recipient, destination city, approximate weight and dispatch date.

faqs.question: How do I get stationery or a new seat?
faqs.answer: Use **Stationery and supplies** for items and toner, and **Seating and workspace** for a new seat, seat change, desk equipment or locker.

faqs.question: Is a travel expense claim an Admin Desk request?
faqs.answer: No. Admin Desk books travel. Claiming the expenses afterwards is an **HR** request under Reimbursement and expenses.

faqs.question: Who can raise a Salesforce case?
faqs.answer: Employees of Sales, Presales and Solutions. Other employees do not see this helpdesk.

faqs.question: How do I raise a Salesforce case?
faqs.answer: Open Helpdesk, choose Salesforce, click **Raise case**, pick a type and reason, describe the problem, add the record link if relevant, and submit. You get a case number.

faqs.question: How do I check my case status?
faqs.answer: Use **My Tickets**. The case shows its status, owner or queue and SLA due date, which come from Salesforce.

faqs.question: Who works on my case?
faqs.answer: A Salesforce assignment rule places it with a user or a queue. The detail page shows the current owner.

faqs.question: What types of issues should I raise?
faqs.answer: Access and permissions, data corrections, reports and dashboards, lead and opportunity setup, integrations and sync, enhancement requests, defects, and how-to questions. [Confirm list with the Salesforce admin.]

faqs.question: What details help the admin fix my issue fast?
faqs.answer: Record link or ID, what you expected, what happened, error message, time, and screenshots.

faqs.question: What is a child case?
faqs.answer: A larger request may be split into child cases so different admins can work in parallel. You see the child cases on the parent case page.

faqs.question: What does Escalated mean?
faqs.answer: The case stayed open too long, so Salesforce moved it to a senior admin or queue and notified them.

faqs.question: Can I add a colleague to my case?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add them as a follower or CC. Salesforce case team members are shown separately.

faqs.question: Why can I not see the Salesforce helpdesk?
faqs.answer: It is available only to Sales, Presales and Solutions. If you believe you should have access, raise an HR ticket to check your department record.
